shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Resting surfaces; depth = border + paper-to-surface shift.

shadows.name: sticky
shadows.purpose: Sticky headers, tab bars, sticky footers.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per view — the main action. Mineral teal fill, white text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0D5C56; color: #FFFFFF; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A4A45; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #083B37; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D5C56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Toolbars and the top bar — 44px hit target, transparent until hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Notifikasi"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10.268 21a2 2 0 0 0 3.464 0"/><path d="M3.262 15.326A1 1 0 0 0 4 17h16a1 1 0 0 0 .74-1.673C19.41 13.956 18 12.499 18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 4.499-1.411 5.956-2.738 7.326"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: transparent; color: #5A6A7A; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: #E9EDF0; color: #15202B; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D5C56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input / Search Field
components.description: Opaque surface, 1px border, teal focus ring — no inset shadow, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 280px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D5DCE3; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #0D5C56; outline: 2px solid #0D5C56; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input input { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; font: 400 14px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #15202B; outline: none; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #5A6A7A; }

components.name: Status Badge (Aktif)
components.description: Locked recipe: text + color + 1px border, soft rectangle. Never color-only.
components.css: .ds-badge-act { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #DCFCE7; color: #166534; border: 1px solid #86EFAC; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 12px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #166534; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: 36px row; active = teal-muted selected row with teal border, never a filled primary block.
components.html: DashboardAset
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: #F1F4F6; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5A6A7A; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #E9EDF0; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #D8EDEA; border-color: #A7D2CC; color: #0D5C56; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D5C56; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The moment of stocktake: a cool-gray clipboard under fluorescent light, a mineral-teal inventory stamp, a barcode label, a stamped ledger line. Institutional without being cold; precise without being sterile. An instrument, not a showcase — surfaces are opaque, borders are 1px, codes are monospace, and status color is earned information, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral teal #0D5C56 on cool paper #F1F4F6 — stewardship, not finance-blue or SaaS purple
Opaque surfaces, 1px borders, structural-only shadows; no glass, no glow, no gradients on chrome
Public Sans for UI, Noto Sans Mono for codes and figures — tabular numerals in every table
Status-first color lock: five status hues are semantic, never decorative
Light-first field UI with an equal dark peer (cool navy) for desk night sessions
Data density 7/10 desktop lists, 5/10 mobile cards; touch targets ≥ 44×44px
Motion 3/10 — feedback only, 120–220ms, single easing, dies under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Status Lock Rule
rules.body: Status hues are semantic, not free accents. The ACT green is never a Simpan button; the LOAN blue is never a link. Dihapus additionally gets muted row treatment — a tombstone, not a task.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: destructive #B42318 belongs to actions (delete/reject). Status DSP owns its own red family. Merging them makes every Dihapus row look like a live delete button.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: No glassmorphism, frosted panels, backdrop-filter on chrome, glow, or gradients on surfaces. Opaque + 1px border is the cheapest way to look trustworthy.

rules.name: The Code Face Rule
rules.body: Asset codes, barcode values, and monetary values are always mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — never the UI sans.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows mark real elevation only. Multi-layer decorative shadows, colored glow, and inset neumorphism are banned.

dos: Do use primary teal #0D5C56 for CTAs, links, focus rings, selection tints, and the brand mark — ≤ 10% of any screen
Do keep every surface opaque with a 1px border (#D5DCE3 light / #2A3544 dark)
Do set active sidebar/nav state as primary-muted + teal border with primary text
Do keep codes, barcodes, and money in Noto Sans Mono with tabular-nums; label copy in Bahasa Indonesia
Do keep exactly one header (the top bar), one version badge, and honest empty states everywhere
Do verify both themes and a 44px touch target before shipping any chrome element
donts: Don't use glass, backdrop-blur, glow, gradients, or purple — anywhere in chrome
Don't hardcode legacy accents (#2D82B7, sky-*, slate gradients) — use semantic tokens
Don't use Soft-UI inset shadows or hover-lift/translate on static controls; motion is feedback only, ≤ 220ms
Don't fill nav or widgets with mock data or dead links; an honest empty state beats a decorated lie
Don't reuse status hues for decoration or the primary color for status
Don't pill-shape CTAs, use emoji in chrome, or style asset codes in the UI sans
